candidates.summary: Member connections bind a short approval to one owner, agent, client and new key; only confirmed PoP creates credentials.
Session-only agent and relationship screens reuse the owner state machine and never reveal another member's identity.
Connection and quota checks cover key-bound credentials, expiry, owner isolation and exact capacity boundaries.
Package relay validates frozen relay.v1 and preserves one parsed object for signing and processing.
Legacy state regression: claims issued before Message.Deliver existed must never reopen agent processing (C1).
Postgres shared state serializes authorization, inbox, idempotency, and claims across relay processes.
Cleanup removes expired payloads and retained metadata even when no client polls.
Trial client checks held/config guards, fixed remote headers, streamed response bounds and timeout without contacting remote services.
Prove product lint detects violations in temporary copies and propagates failure.
